versions.changelog:
Initial release of clack-prompts.

- Build beautiful interactive Node.js command-line apps using @clack/prompts.
- Supports various prompt types: text, password, confirm, select, autocomplete, multiselect, grouped prompts, and more.
- Includes utilities for spinners, progress bars, task runners, styled logging, and streaming logs.
- Comprehensive documentation provided with usage examples and API reference.
